Name: Dwarf Expanded Stock
Author: MsSadisticNight049
Description:
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Dwarf will now sell Fairy Dust and Monster Musk for 1000g. I felt the items fit the theme of the Dwarf's shop, and also just wanted an eaiser way to get Fairy Dust.[/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8] Also this is my first mod and my first time posting on here so sorry if this page is a little wonky, I made the header on my phone on Procreate Pocket so sorry if it's not the best. Also ignore the textures of some of the items and UI, I have mods on my save file that change the textures, it will appear normally for anyone else (that is if you don't also have mods that change the textures).[/color][/size]

How To Install:
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]You will need to have SMAPI and ContentPatcher installed for this mod to work. After downloading the file, extract the file and place its contents into your 'Mods' folder.[/color][/size]
